title: Quasi-coherence from the two principal-open localization conditions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose that for every affine open $W\subseteq X$ and $a\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_X)$: (1) every $s\in\Gamma(D_W(a),\mathcal M)$ satisfies $t|_{D_W(a)}=a^n s$ for some $n\geq0$ and $t\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal M)$; (2) every $t\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal M)$ vanishing on $D_W(a)$ satisfies $a^n t=0$ for some $n\geq0$. Then $\mathcal M$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent].

source.place: isQuasicoherent_of_forall_isAffineOpen, lines 147-161; EGA I, Theoreme 1.4.1; Stacks Tags 01IA and 01LA

proof.text: On each affine open W=Spec A, the two conditions express precisely that restriction from W to each principal D(a) is localization of Gamma(W,M) at a. Invertibility of a on D(a) supplies the unit condition. The universal property gives an isomorphism from the associated sheaf of Gamma(W,M) to M on all principal opens, hence on W. The associated sheaf is quasi-coherent; affine opens cover X, so M is quasi-coherent. The existing Lean criterion proves this through isLocalizing_restrict_fromSpec_of_forall and presentationOfIsIsoFromTildeGamma, with affine-open descent.

theorem isQuasicoherent_of_forall_isAffineOpen (M : X.Modules)
    (h₁ : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → ∀ (f : Γ(X, W)) (s : Γ(M, X.basicOpen f)),
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(M, W)), M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op t =
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op f ^ n • s)
    (h₂ : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → ∀ (f : Γ(X, W)) (t : Γ(M, W)),
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op t = 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n • t = 0) :
    M.IsQuasicoherent
